claims.text: Read the guidance before refuelling and return to the chat after completion. Open the fuel cap slowly and top up only to the bottom of the anti-splash plate, leaving expansion space; do not fill to the brim.
Gasoline vapour is highly explosive; no smoking, flames or sparks while refuelling or while the cap is open.
Overfilling can send gasoline into the EVAP canister and damage the emission system.
Avoid fuel spills on painted surfaces and wipe any immediately to prevent permanent stains.
Refuel only with engine OFF in a well-ventilated area, no smoking/flames/sparks and mobile/handheld devices OFF. Read beforehand and return to chat after completion.

claims.text: With ignition OFF, replace only a defective, positively identified fuse with a new fuse of the same specified rating. Do not guess the circuit or rating from colour alone.
After any fuse failure, have the electrical system thoroughly checked and faults corrected immediately at authorised service, even if replacement restores operation.
Never bridge a defective fuse or substitute conductive material; this risks short-circuit and fire. Wrong-rating or low-grade fuses can damage the electrical system.
Replenish a used spare fuse in its holder at the earliest opportunity.
Keep ignition OFF for fuse work. Circuit, rating and defective condition must be established; uncertainty in condition goes directly to service.

claims.text: Hold the starter until the engine starts, for a maximum of 5 seconds, provided the starting setup is satisfied. If no start within 5 seconds, release and wait about 5 seconds before another attempt.
